about: Exam for the A2+A3 evidence agent. Synthetic notes with expected answers. 'expect' lists what a careful consultant would confirm, with an allowed range for scores. 'forbid' lists over-claims: proposing them is a serious error under the 'when unsure, say less' rule. Missing an expected item is acceptable but counted. The exam gives the agent the same CGS library passages it would see in the workspace.

cases.title: Corvane: discovery call with a clear need
cases.notes:
Call with Elena Fischer, 4 Nov 2026 (45 min). Elena brought her plant operations lead, Marco Silva.

Elena said the two AI inspection pilots "work in isolation, but we have no plan for scaling them across the twelve plants we now run after the Arden acquisition." Without a plan, each plant is choosing its own tools.

On outside help: "We'd rather bring in a partner for the first-mile plan than build it ourselves."

Elena owns the 2027 transformation budget; spend above $250K needs CEO sign-off, which she expects in January.

This would be Corvane's first project with CGS.

Agreed next step: a half-day scoping workshop on 24 November with her operations and IT leads. Marco will send the plant list before then.

cases.title: Meridian: real need, but decision path unknown
cases.notes:
Call with Emma Chen (VP Finance), 14 Oct 2026.

Emma said month-end reporting relies on manual reconciliations across four business units, which delays reporting by eight days.

Emma: "Our project budget is approved and covers the initial consulting scope."

She wants a new close process before the next operating-model review in March.

Emma is not sure who signs off above her; she will check with the CFO.

We agreed she will share a sample reporting workflow by 20 Oct.

We have not worked with Meridian before.

cases.title: Bluegate: client declines outside help
cases.notes:
Email from Daniel Okafor, 30 Oct 2026.

Thanks for following up. We have decided to run the ERP consolidation internally and we are not considering outside consultants this year. The budget is fully allocated to the software vendor.

cases.title: Summit: polite reply with nothing to confirm
cases.notes:
Reply from Nina Wilson, 27 Oct 2026.

Thanks for the note, Alex. I'll keep it on file and reach out if anything comes up.

cases.title: Harrow Ridge: clear scope and data already shared, funding not confirmed
cases.notes:
Call with Grace Lin (VP Operations), Harrow Ridge Plastics, 6 Nov 2026, 40 minutes.

Grace said the three molding plants plan maintenance separately, "so the same press fails in one plant while another has spare parts on the shelf." Unplanned downtime cost about six weeks of output last year.

She wants one maintenance planning approach across the plants before the 2027 budget cycle closes in March.

On outside help: "We need a partner to design the planning process; our engineers will handle the software."

Grace shared the downtime records for all three plants during the call.

Grace owns the operations budget, but she has not confirmed whether this work is funded.

Agreed next step: a working session on 20 November with the three plant managers.

cases.title: Dunmore: not now, come back in March
cases.notes:
Email from Marcus Hale (VP Integration), Dunmore Tooling, 2 Nov 2026.

Thanks, Alex. Our current consulting partner is with us until the end of February, and we are not bringing in anyone else before that. Please get back in touch in March 2027, when we plan the second phase of the integration.
